block.name: assign_task_to_genie

input.task_instructions:
TICKET ID: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"foreach","line":"bc05a2ae","path":["id"]}')}
Analyze the complete Zendesk conversation for the provided ticket.

Identify the customer's current issue and latest request. Review the conversation chronologically and use the available knowledge base to identify relevant technical information.

Determine the most recent customer reply and use its provided date/time to calculate how much time has elapsed since the customer last responded.

Return:

A short summary of the issue.
The customer's latest request.
2 to 4 key points from the conversation that are relevant to resolving the issue.
The date and time of the customer's most recent reply.
The elapsed time since the customer's most recent reply return only the number of hour.
The recommended next investigation or support action.
A short professional draft response to the customer.

Base your analysis only on the ticket conversation and available knowledge. Clearly distinguish confirmed information from possible causes. Do not invent technical findings, claim a root cause without evidence, or make promises about fixes or timelines.
